root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `match->flow` must still denote a live allocation when `free(match->flow)` executes.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Each `minimatch_destroy()` call in this parse-flow cleanup chain must free a live `match->flow` value, not the same `match->flow` already freed by an earlier cleanup call in the same request.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable cleanup path reaches `free(match->flow)` twice on the same underlying miniflow allocation: `ofctl_parse_flows__()` frees it first, then `ofctl_parse_flow()` reaches a second `minimatch_destroy(&fm.match)` on the unchanged stale pointer. The fixed program removes that caller-side second destroy, so the only observed `free(match->flow)` for the request has no previous `match->flow` free to repeat.

edges.relation: The pointer freed by the first `minimatch_destroy()` call remains stored unchanged in `fm.match.flow` when control returns to the caller-side cleanup.
The stale `fm.match.flow` pointer from the caller-side cleanup is passed unchanged into the second `minimatch_destroy()` invocation, whose `free(match->flow)` is the ASan sink.
